title: Maximum EMF calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the maximum induced EMF using Em = nBSω = 2πnBSf.

title: RMS voltage conversion
description: Essential: Student must convert maximum EMF to RMS primary voltage using U1 = Em/√2.

title: Transformer turns ratio
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate the turns ratio n1/n2 = U1/U2 from the given motor voltage.

title: Secondary current calculation
description: Important: Student must determine total secondary current from the power rating and number of motors using I2 = 2P/U2.

title: Primary current via transformer
description: Important: Student must apply the transformer current ratio I1 = (n2/n1)I2 to find the ammeter reading.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units throughout calculations (V, A, Hz, m², T).

title: Confusing peak with RMS
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses maximum EMF directly as the primary voltage without dividing by √2.

title: Incorrect power calculation
description: Pitfall: Student fails to account for both motors when calculating total secondary power or current.

title: Reversed transformer ratio
description: Pitfall: Student inverts the voltage or current ratio (e.g., uses n1/n2 for current instead of n2/n1).
